identity.statusNote: Twitch's own streaming software is no longer actively developed; Twitch itself recommends third-party tools like OBS Studio or Streamlabs instead.

limits.en: Entirely free streaming/broadcasting software, no paid tiers.

keyLimits.en: Entirely free desktop broadcasting software with no paid tiers.

cautions.en: Product is discontinued/no longer actively developed by Twitch; no pricing to verify since it was always free, but the tool itself should be treated as legacy.

capabilities.en: Free desktop streaming/broadcasting software built specifically for streaming to Twitch, with built-in scene and overlay tools.
Simplified setup wizard aimed at first-time streamers compared to general-purpose broadcasting tools.

limitations.en: No longer actively maintained/developed; feature set has stalled compared to actively developed alternatives.
Tied specifically to streaming toward Twitch, unlike general-purpose tools that support multiple platforms.

reason.en: Overlapping use in live communication/streaming setups for creator communities, though not a direct broadcasting-software substitute.
